messages.content: Classify only what the supplied executable evidence supports. Do not repair doctrine or infer a constitution. Preserve contradictions and return only contracted JSON.

E1 finance-witness-bit: makeCommodityLot writes unit=commodity-utterance, intrinsicPrice=null, priceFormation=counterparty-border-offer; its assay says titleOrFungibilityAssayed=false and globalGluingClaimed=false. E2 finance-border-price: quotes accept an arbitrary nonempty consideration.unit; ask and bid are comparable only when unit, kind, monetaryClaim, and x402Applicable are identical; selectionAuthority is counterparties-only. E3 finance-bilateral-observation: reconciliation requires distinct buyer debit and seller credit book entries linked to an identical receipt, equal amount and unit, and reports globalLedgerCreated=false. E4 UOA-runtime: current exchanges book at least bilateral-observation, rmn-conformance-credit, and portfolio-admission-credit; records explicitly say centralRegisterUsed=false and centralCfo=false. E5 inference-fabric: completed work is accounted in provider-specific denominations including claude-code-cli-invocations, google-ai-studio-api-requests, and github-models-api-requests. E6 RMN-residue: price/erasure residues require one exact unit and retain Chu, connection, price/erasure, and economic-current/affinity as separate typed carriers; the profile states executable conformance is not proof of fraud, overtwistedness, C4, C5, C6, or chain necessity. E7 EVM-effect: the gyrobifastigial effect-cell profile says a cell commitment at every listed scale is a mutually signed HolonomySeamLedger sourceReceipt, and consumeEffectAuthority sends closeSeam before accepting the effect receipt. E8 FOUR-admission: the separate FOUR profile says consensusRequired exactly when par and tensor differ and explicitly rejects the claim that every valid commuting square automatically requires consensus. E9 notebook-synthesis: the WIT/dervish report calls WIT the conserved currency of settling flow, but its source packet prompt instructed the model to define WIT in that way and synthesize the connection. E10 repository-navigation-inquiry: a verified inference-fabric inquiry reports that the current fabric has no structured repository index, that workers otherwise require full-tree dumps, and that context assembly is nondeterministic. Classify the supported current-state conclusions, conflicts between current mechanisms, propositions not established by this evidence, and the next deterministic measurements needed.

conflicts.left: E1 writes unit=commodity-utterance with intrinsicPrice=null; E2 accepts any nonempty consideration.unit; E5 records work in provider-specific denominations — units are fragmented across participants.
conflicts.right: E3 requires amount and unit to be identical across buyer-debit and seller-credit entries for reconciliation; cross-unit bilateral pairs cannot satisfy this requirement under the current protocol.

conflicts.left: E9 report designates WIT the conserved currency of settling flow.
conflicts.right: E9 source records that the model was instructed to define WIT that way; E5 shows actual accounting uses provider-specific denominations. WIT's currency claim rests on definitional injection, not independent observation.

conflicts.left: E7 gyrobifastigial profile requires a mutually signed HolonomySeamLedger sourceReceipt at every listed scale — mutual signing is a universal per-scale commitment.
conflicts.right: E8 FOUR profile explicitly rejects the proposition that every valid commuting square automatically requires consensus and sets consensusRequired only when par and tensor differ.

conflicts.left: E7 requires consumeEffectAuthority to dispatch closeSeam before accepting the effect receipt, asserting a deterministic protocol ordering.
conflicts.right: E10 reports that context assembly in the current fabric is nondeterministic; the closeSeam-before-accept ordering guarantee cannot be confirmed as reliably enforceable under these fabric conditions.

notEstablished.reason: E3 reports globalLedgerCreated=false; E4 reports centralRegisterUsed=false and centralCfo=false. No affirmative code path or activation condition for a central ledger appears in the evidence.

E5 shows fragmented provider-specific denominations; E2 permits arbitrary units with no convergence mechanism; E4 books heterogeneous credit types. No shared unit of account or reduction rule appears in the evidence.

notEstablished.proposition: WIT is empirically grounded as a conserved settlement currency independent of its definitional injection.
notEstablished.reason: E9 source packet explicitly records that the model was instructed to define WIT as the conserved currency and synthesize the connection. No independent accounting record or conservation law is cited in any evidence item.

notEstablished.proposition: RMN conformance credit implies chain necessity, overtwistedness, C4, C5, or C6.
notEstablished.reason: E6 explicitly states that executable conformance is not proof of fraud, overtwistedness, C4, C5, C6, or chain necessity. E4 books rmn-conformance-credit under this same non-implicative profile.

notEstablished.proposition: Mutual signing at every scale (E7) is compatible with the selective consensus rule (E8) without additional qualification.
notEstablished.reason: E7 asserts mutual signing unconditionally at every listed scale; E8 rejects universal consensus. Whether mutual signing constitutes consensus in E8's sense and whether E8's par==tensor exemption applies to any of E7's scales is unresolved.

notEstablished.proposition: Provider-specific denominations in E5 are interconvertible or reduce to a common unit for cross-provider settlement.
notEstablished.reason: No exchange rate, denomination bridge, or conversion function is described in any evidence item. E3's equal-unit requirement makes cross-denomination bilateral observation irreconcilable without such a mechanism.

Determine whether 'mutually signed' in E7's HolonomySeamLedger sourceReceipt is implemented by the same protocol path as E8's consensus mechanism, or whether they are mechanically distinct with independent triggering conditions.

Inspect the reconciliation path for any cross-unit conversion bridge that would allow bilateral observations in different provider denominations (E5) to satisfy E3's equal-unit constraint without manual denomination alignment.
